{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Verify premises
assert 'loyal' in sales['customer_segment'].unique(), "'loyal' not in customer_segment"
assert 'completed' in sales['status'].unique(), "'completed' not in status"

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_numeric'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter: completed orders from LOYAL customers
filtered = sales[
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (sales['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Check if any QA orders were missed
assert len(filtered[filtered['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]) == 0, "QA orders found in filtered data"

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = filtered['revenue_numeric'].mean()

print(f"Number of completed LOYAL orders: {len(filtered)}")
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
